title: Community Solar Subscriptions: Limits per Customer and per Premise
content:
A customer may hold up to 3 Community Solar Subscriptions, each for a different premise. A subscription counts while its status is waitlisted, active or cancellation pending. Only one live subscription may exist for one premise, under the plan term on live subscriptions per premise.

## How the limits read

| Status of a subscription on record | Counts toward the customer's 3 | Live for its premise |
|---|---|---|
| Waitlisted | Yes | Yes |
| Active | Yes | Yes |
| Cancellation pending | Yes | Yes |
| Closed | No | No |
| Withdrawn | No | No |

- **Per customer.** The 3 subscriptions a customer may hold must each be for a different premise; two of them may never share a premise.
- **Per premise.** Whether a premise already has a live subscription is judged from the system record: the subscriptions on record for that premise and their status. A customer's statement about the premise does not replace that record. The premise compared is the premise the new subscription is requested for, the premise whose utility account would receive the solar credits.

## Hypothetical cases

| Hypothetical situation | Reading |
|---|---|
| A customer holds two active subscriptions and one closed one, and asks to subscribe a third premise that has no live subscription. | Two subscriptions count; a third, for a different premise, stays within the limit of 3. |
| A customer holds one waitlisted, one active and one cancellation-pending subscription, each on its own premise. | All three count; the customer already holds 3. |
| A premise carries a subscription in cancellation pending, and a new subscription is requested for the same premise. | The pending subscription is still live, so a second live subscription may not exist for that premise. |
| A premise carries only a withdrawn subscription. | Nothing live exists for that premise. |
